item.title: 19 Aug — PIX-first rails, tighter spreads
item.description:
Private — Head of Products
Tonight was light on fresh, cite-able moves in our window. Shipping a concept issue instead — one mechanism that would move our spread and conversion in LATAM and India without changing our on-chain fee constraint.
